blurb:
Limited time offer: FREE RE-RIDES!

Treasure Hunt: The Ride is an interactive theme park ride adventure that the entire family can enjoy and compete for the highest scores!

The ticket allows you to ride the attraction over an over again in a single calendar day, and compete with family and friends for the highest scores! Your ticket will be valid at anytime during regular opening hours!

Built exclusively for Cannery Row in Monterey, the pirate-themed adventure is part ride and part game, and was inspired by the area’s unique maritime history.

You'll be in the middle of the action as you use interactive devices to collect treasure and ward off fierce skeleton pirates and sea creatures, while traveling through underground caverns in mining carts.

Come join the fun and compete with friends and family for the highest scores!
